title: Ignite All Blocks
description: A Minecraft datapack that allows flint and steel to ignite all blocks.
body:
You can ignite nearly all blocks!

![Ignite Villagers' Houses](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4fbf35bd94e4ecd5f12741127bd62aa5d12eb83f.png)
## Features

Ignite grass block, dirt, stone, ores, planks, torches, even flowers and grass!

You can sneak so flint and steel can be used normally.

## Dependencies
* (Required) [Bookshelf View](https://modrinth.com/project/rkt9Av0Z)
* (Required) [Bookshelf Block](https://modrinth.com/project/JTQNFXZm)

## Demo
[Watch Video on Bilibili](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1mjmwBKEs3/?share_source=copy_web&vd_source=c9cd315de687845cb7a2d835d3200b37)

## Known Issues
* Doors, beds, pistons may broken accidentally when iginting.
* Blocks with gui cannot be ignited.
